title: A Socio-political history of Marathi Theatre, Vol 3

vibeProfile.oneLine: A socio-political history of Marathi theatre, volume three.

summary: The third volume of Makarand Sathe's monumental study completes his socio-political history of Marathi theatre, bringing the account toward the present and one of India's most politically alive theatrical traditions. It ties the plays, playwrights and movements of the Marathi stage to the social and political currents of their times. A pioneering, deeply researched scholarly work that treats theatre as a living part of Maharashtra's public life.
whyReadIt: The concluding volume of Sathe's pioneering socio-political history of Marathi theatre. Deeply researched.
